intent: Individual written club reminders preserve meeting details, accept equivalent before-phrase and before-clause structures and edit a pronoun-agreement/preposition example without prescribing exact personal wording.
picturePurpose: Coded information fields, equivalent before structures and specific sentence repairs directly expose the writing relationships; no invented campus map or tool procedure.

workshop.title: 把集合信息和before写清楚
workshop.instruction: 先检查日期、钟点和具体门，再比较两种before写法，最后改一句不通顺的提醒。自己的2—4句可以换自然的写法，但不能换集合点或颠倒先后。

items.label: 日期、钟点和具体门都保留
items.prompt: 写前先核对哪三个原题信息？
items.reason: 周二、四点和绿门已核对。再把三个信息自然地写进句子，不能只写门口。
items.hint: green gate与main school gate不是同一集合点；原题没有要求写路线或加上具体距离。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。园艺社团周二四点在绿门集合。告诉新同学集合信息，并提醒先听老师讲工具用法。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 写前信息核对卡
composeBrief.hint: 不能靠熟悉的旧句子替换这次信息。
composeBrief.wrong: 原题是周二四点在绿门集合，不是周三、每天或五点。笼统的时间和学校附近都不能代替给定钟点与绿门；学校正门也不是绿门。

choices.label: Tuesday
Wednesday
Every day
at five
at four
at some time
the main school gate
the green gate
somewhere near school

items.label: 两种before写法，先后意思相同
items.prompt: before后接短语或完整分句，怎样都保留先听说明？
items.reason: 所选before结构与完整句子已对应。自己的写法可以不同，但“先听说明”这个意思不能变。
items.hint: before using any tools与before you use any tools都可以表达使用工具之前。两种都对，不强迫只写参考的一种句式。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。园艺社团周二四点在绿门集合。告诉新同学集合信息，并提醒先听老师讲工具用法。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: before＋动作短语／before＋分句
composeBrief.hint: 选一种结构，再选与它一致且意思完整的提醒。
composeBrief.wrong: before不是after；before using和before you use都可成立，不能省掉听说明或机械混搭。

choices.label: before＋动作短语：before using any tools
before＋完整分句：before you use any tools
Please listen to the teacher before using any tools.
Before you use any tools, please listen to the teacher.
Use the tools first and listen to the teacher afterwards.

items.label: 检查句子，再写两到四句
items.prompt: 哪句把人称、时间表达和集合信息写通顺了？
items.reason: 示例句与任务形式已核对。再检查自己的短文有没有完整说明集合信息与工具前的提醒。
items.hint: 这里改的是一个示例句；自己的短文不必与示例逐字相同。写完整句子，不用几个词代替整个任务。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。园艺社团周二四点在绿门集合。告诉新同学集合信息，并提醒先听老师讲工具用法。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 示例句检查卡
composeBrief.wrong: We后用meet，钟点用at four，星期用on Tuesday。成稿要2—4句并包含工具前先听说明；只有关键词或单句集合信息都不完整。

fields.label: 哪句在本题语境下通顺？

choices.label: We meets by the green gate at four on Tuesday.
We meet by the green gate at four on Tuesday.
We meet by the green gate on four at Tuesday.
Write only the words Tuesday, four and gate.
Write two to four complete sentences, including the reminder.
Write one meeting sentence and leave out the tools reminder.

transfer.stem: Which outline preserves the new details and the before relationship?
transfer.passage:
A different written reminder
The library volunteer group meets by the library side entrance at five on Thursday. Write two to four complete English sentences giving new volunteers these details. Remind them to listen to the librarian’s instructions before sorting books. You may use a before phrase or a before clause if it clearly expresses the same order.

options.text: Copy the garden-club Tuesday/four/green-gate notice and ignore the new activity.
Give Thursday at five and the library side entrance, then use either clear before structure to remind new volunteers to listen to the librarian before sorting books.
Change the side entrance to the main school gate and place listening after sorting.
List three isolated words without complete sentences or any reminder.

answer.display: Give Thursday at five and the library side entrance, then use either clear before structure to remind new volunteers to listen to the librarian before sorting books.

explanation.strategy: 先更新集合信息，再用合适的before结构表达先后。

steps.text: 这次是周四五点，在图书馆侧门集合。
steps.reason: 不能套用园艺社团的周二四点绿门，也不能自行换成学校正门。

steps.text: 先听图书管理员说明，再整理书；before后接短语或分句都可。
steps.reason: 句式可以不同，但先后关系和完整提醒必须保留。

distractors.reason: 沿用旧题的日期、钟点、地点和活动，没有更新信息。
集合点改错，先听说明也被颠倒成后听。
只有词语，没有完整句子和提醒。

explanation.pitfall: 背了before句型，却把本次的地点或先后意思写错。
